result.instructions: Tools for QuickInvoice, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are overdue for our company, and how much is still open?"; "Find the customer with tax id RO12345678 and show their last invoices."; "Create an invoice for SC Exemplu SRL: two hours of consulting at 250 RON net, 21% VAT.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes QuickInvoice data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quickinvoice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quickinvoice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quickinvoice_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. quickinvoice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quickinvoice_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices of the company that owns the API key, newest first. Filter by status, type, customer, search text or date range. Uses GET /api/v1/invoices.

customer_id.description: Only invoices of this customer id.

tools.name: quickinvoice_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its lines, totals, status and customer. Uses GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: The invoice id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: quickinvoice_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for the company that owns the API key (POST /api/v1/invoices). unit_price is the NET price per unit; VAT is computed from tax_rate. A new invoice can use a number in its series. Confirm the customer, lines, amounts and series with the user before calling. Needs the invoices:write key permission.

customer_name.description: Customer name as it appears on the invoice.

customer_cif.description: Customer tax id (CIF / CUI), e.g. RO12345678.

series.description: Invoice series. Omit to use the company's default series.

tools.name: quickinvoice_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers of the company, with optional text search. Uses GET /api/v1/customers.

tools.name: quickinvoice_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Uses GET /api/v1/customers/{id}.

customer_id.description: The customer id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: quickinvoice_list_products
tools.title: List products and services
tools.description: List the company's products and services (read-only in the API), with optional search, category and type filters. Uses GET /api/v1/products.

category_id.description: Only items of this category id.

tools.name: quickinvoice_get_product
tools.title: Get a product or service
tools.description: Get one product or service by id, with its price and VAT rate. Uses GET /api/v1/products/{id}.

product_id.description: The product id (from the matching list tool).
